create_Pareto: create a Pareto Type 1 distribution with scale and alpha parameters using torch.distributions.Pareto
sample_Pareto: sample from a Pareto distribution with given scale and alpha using Pareto.sample()
compute_Pareto_mean: compute the mean of a Pareto distribution, returning inf for alpha <= 1
compute_Pareto_variance: compute the variance of a Pareto distribution, returning inf for alpha <= 2
compute_Pareto_entropy: compute the differential entropy of a Pareto distribution using Pareto.entropy()
